title: AI unchecked: Check and validate an AI-generated forecast before it is used for a public decision
description: No institution holds the power or duty to check and validate an AI-generated forecast before it is used for a public decision

precedents.what_it_does: High-risk AI must allow effective human oversight, guard against over-reliance, and deployers must assign competent people to oversee it.
precedents.fit_note: Cameroon could require a named forecaster to validate AI forecasts before public use, without adopting the whole AI Act.

precedents.instrument: FCC findings on the Hawaii false missile alert (2018)
precedents.what_it_does: Recommended second-person verification before any live alert is released.
precedents.fit_note: A simple procedure rule, cheap to adopt.

title: Two in charge: Decide to alert the public
description: Several institutions hold 'decide to alert the public' and no text says who leads

precedents.what_it_does: For some hazards the national government pushes alerts automatically, removing delays in local decisions.

precedents.what_it_does: Only authorised alerting authorities may originate alerts.
precedents.fit_note: Cameroon could name the authorised originators per hazard.

precedents.what_it_does: Clear roles: the weather service issues, the disaster centre coordinates, the ICT authority disseminates, with one common alert format.
precedents.fit_note: Naming one lead per step avoids two bodies claiming the same decision.

title: No procedure: Approve an AI-drafted alert through a human validation step before release

title: Nobody in charge: Order mobile operators to relay a public alert
description: No institution holds the power or duty to order mobile operators to relay a public alert

precedents.what_it_does: Mobile operators must relay public warnings from the national public warning system to the end-users concerned.
precedents.fit_note: A decree or ART decision could create the same duty; Cameroon would need to name the authority that originates the warning.

precedents.instrument: Republic Act No. 10639, Free Mobile Disaster Alerts Act (2014)
precedents.what_it_does: Operators must send free alerts with content from named agencies; fines and franchise suspension for non-compliance.
precedents.fit_note: Close to Cameroon's situation (a developing country with frequent hazards); requires naming content providers and setting penalties.

precedents.instrument: 47 CFR Part 10 (Wireless Emergency Alerts) and WARN Act
precedents.what_it_does: Separates who originates alerts (authorised authorities), the national gateway, and the operators who transmit them.
precedents.fit_note: Participation is voluntary in the US; a mandatory duty (EU, Philippines) may suit Cameroon better.

title: Nobody answers for harm: Answer for harm caused by a wrong alert
description: No institution holds the power or duty to answer for harm caused by a wrong alert

precedents.what_it_does: Limits the liability of operators that transmit alerts in good faith.
precedents.fit_note: Protects operators but does not say who compensates victims; Cameroon would need to decide both.

precedents.what_it_does: Sets obligations for AI providers and deployers, including monitoring and serious-incident reporting, which help establish who failed.
precedents.fit_note: Liability for damages itself is left to other EU and national rules.

title: AI unchecked: Report that sensors feeding the AI are down and the forecast is unreliable

precedents.what_it_does: Automatic logging and instructions describing accuracy, limits and the conditions under which the system works as intended.

precedents.what_it_does: Measure and monitor AI systems in operation, including data quality.
precedents.fit_note: Voluntary method.
